WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(chave, valor), '{}'::jsonb) AS c
  FROM bot_fluxo_config WHERE fluxo = 'motorista_mdfe'
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO bot_sessao (fluxo, telefone, conversation_id, ultimo_evento_em)
  VALUES ('motorista_mdfe', $1, $2, $3::timestamptz)
  ON CONFLICT (fluxo, telefone) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *, true AS nova
), marca AS (
  UPDATE bot_sessao SET ultimo_evento_em = GREATEST(ultimo_evento_em, $3::timestamptz)
   WHERE fluxo = 'motorista_mdfe' AND telefone = $1
), s AS (
  SELECT * FROM ins
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.*, false AS nova FROM bot_sessao b
  WHERE b.fluxo = 'motorista_mdfe' AND b.telefone = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
)
SELECT s.*, cfg.c AS config FROM s, cfg;

UPDATE bot_sessao
   SET estado = 'AGUARDANDO_DAMDFE',
       tentativas = CASE WHEN estado = 'AGUARDANDO_DAMDFE' THEN tentativas ELSE 0 END,
       contexto = jsonb_set(contexto, '{arquivos}',
                  CASE WHEN ultimo_arquivo_em > clock_timestamp() - make_interval(secs => $3::int + 30)
                       THEN COALESCE(contexto->'arquivos', '[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END || to_jsonb($2::text)),
       ultimo_arquivo_em = clock_timestamp(),
       updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1::uuid AND estado <> 'VALIDANDO'
RETURNING id, to_char(ultimo_arquivo_em, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') AS marca;

UPDATE bot_sessao
   SET estado = 'VALIDANDO', updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1::uuid
   AND estado = 'AGUARDANDO_DAMDFE'
   AND to_char(ultimo_arquivo_em, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') = $2
RETURNING id, contexto, tentativas;

parameters.query:
WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE bot_sessao
     SET estado = $2, contexto = $3::jsonb, tentativas = $4::int,
         conversation_id = COALESCE($5, conversation_id), updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING id
), x AS (SELECT $6::jsonb AS r),
reg AS (
  INSERT INTO mdfe_atendimento (sessao_id, conversation_id, telefone, http_status, status, codigo,
                                protocolo, chave_mdfe, numero_mdfe, mensagem, retorno_api, encerrado_em)
  SELECT $1::uuid, r->>'conversation_id', r->>'telefone', (r->>'http_status')::int, r->>'status', r->>'codigo',
         r->>'protocolo', r->>'chave_mdfe', r->>'numero_mdfe', r->>'mensagem',
         NULLIF(r->'retorno_api', 'null'::jsonb), NULLIF(r->>'encerrado_em', '')::timestamptz
    FROM x WHERE r <> 'null'::jsonb
  RETURNING id
), arq AS (
  INSERT INTO mdfe_atendimento_arquivo (atendimento_id, message_id)
  SELECT reg.id, a
    FROM reg, x, jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(x.r->'arquivos', '[]'::jsonb)) a
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM upd) AS sessao_id, (SELECT id FROM reg) AS atendimento_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM arq) AS arquivos_gravados;
